commit.message:
feat: realign moderation actions with explicit delete and age review workflows (#78)

* feat: add DELETE action type and NIP-09 kind 5 publishing helper

- Add publishKind5Deletion to nip86.ts: constructs and publishes a
  kind 5 deletion request event from the admin key
- Add DELETE to handleModerateMedia action union type
- 3 new tests for kind 5 publishing (success, relay error, network error)

* feat: add /api/bulk-moderate endpoint and age review config routes

- bulk-moderate.ts: server-side iteration for age-restrict-all,
  un-age-restrict-all, and delete-all operations on a pubkey
- Routes /api/age-review/config GET/PUT for auto-delete toggle
- WebSocket relay query for event enumeration, imeta tag parsing
  for media hash extraction from video events (kind 34235/34236)
- 9 tests for validation, hash extraction, and deduplication

* feat: wire age review transitions to bulk content actions with auto-delete config

- Add age_review_config D1 table (key-value, auto_delete_on_deny default true)
- getAgeReviewConfig / updateAgeReviewConfig exported from age-review.ts
- State transitions fire bulk actions: restrict -> age-restrict-all,
  clear -> un-age-restrict-all, deny -> delete-all (if auto-delete enabled)
- Cron auto-close fires bulk delete on expired cases (if configured)
- Bulk actions are non-critical side effects (try/catch, logged on failure)
- 3 new config tests, existing 44 age-review tests still pass

* feat: add DeleteConfirmDialog with two-click confirmation flow

AlertDialog-based confirmation for destructive actions. Shows summary
on first click, executes on confirm. Supports pending state and
custom labels. 4 tests.

* feat: add DELETE action, bulkModerate, and age review config to adminApi

- Add DELETE to ModerationAction type
- bulkModerate(), deleteMedia(), publishDeletionRequest() API methods
- getAgeReviewConfig / updateAgeReviewConfig API methods
- /api/publish-deletion worker route for NIP-09 kind 5 publishing
- All new methods bound in useAdminApi hook

* feat: composable EventActions component with media + event actions

Extracts event-level and media-level action buttons into a reusable
component. Covers ban/restore, delete (banevent + NIP-09), block/unblock
media, age restrict/remove restriction, delete media, and combined
delete event & media. Reversible actions use outline buttons, irreversible
use destructive with DeleteConfirmDialog confirmation.

* feat: composable UserActions component with bulk operations

User-level actions: ban/unban user, bulk age-restrict all media, bulk
delete all content. Bulk actions hidden in age-review context (handled
by case transitions instead). DeleteConfirmDialog for irreversible bulk
delete.

* refactor: replace inline action buttons with EventActions and UserActions

ReportDetail drops from 2190 to 1123 lines by extracting event/media/user
actions into composable components. Removes 8 mutations, 5 confirmation
dialogs, verification state, and the reasonSelector. Keeps resolution
actions (Reopen/Dismiss), BulkDeleteByKind, and Create Label inline.

* feat: add EventActions to banned events list in Events tab

Replaces standalone Unban button with full EventActions component on
banned events (restore + delete). Removes dead unbanEventMutation and
its confirmation dialog.

* feat: add UserActions with bulk operations to Users tab

Selected user card now shows bulk age-restrict and bulk delete actions
via the UserActions component alongside existing ban/allow buttons.

* feat: wire AgeReviewDetail with auto-delete confirmation and manual fallback

Deny & Close shows DeleteConfirmDialog when auto_delete_on_deny is
enabled. Terminal denied cases show UserActions for manual deletion
when auto-delete is disabled.

* feat: add AgeReviewSettings toggle for auto-delete on deny/expire

* fix: resolve strict type errors for CI (tsconfig.app.json)

* fix: replace `as any` with typed casts for eslint no-explicit-any

* fix: address code review findings

- Add short-form video kinds 21/22 to VIDEO_KINDS for bulk operations
- Make AgeReviewEnv extend BulkModerateEnv, removing unsafe type cast
- Add AgeReviewDetail tests for Deny & Delete vs Deny & Close paths
- Remove duplicate ban button from UserManagement (UserActions handles it)
- Use outline variant for reversible ban button to match convention

* fix: audit log for unblock/unrestrict, delete summary text, apiRequest consistency

- Add logDecision to unblockMediaMutation for audit trail on reversals
- Update "Delete All Content" summary to mention events, not just media
- Use apiRequest helper for updateAgeReviewConfig (add PUT to method union)

* fix(worker): harden bulk moderation flows

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
feat: create Zendesk ticket on age review restriction (#76)

* feat: create Zendesk ticket on age review restriction, sync deadline field

When a moderator restricts an account, create an internal Zendesk ticket
so T&S has visibility before any parent email arrives. When the parent
email comes in later, update that ticket with the parent as requester
and send the outreach email, avoiding duplicates.

Both ticket types set category/issue and a deadline custom field
(ZENDESK_FIELD_AGE_REVIEW_DEADLINE, dormant until configured in
Zendesk admin). All Zendesk ops are non-critical side effects.

* fix(age-review): clean up zendesk restriction flow

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>

feat: enrich age review UI with profile data (#75)

* feat: enrich age review UI with profile data

Replace raw hex pubkeys with UserIdentifier/UserDisplayName components
in the Age Review tab. Moderators now see display names, NIP-05, and
avatars instead of opaque hex strings. Adds useAuthor mock to tests.

* fix(age-review): preserve hex copy workflow
